description.en: Left-sidebar panel that extracts text from images with local Tesseract OCR (Chinese + English) and translates it via the built-in translator (anonymous Bing, no API key). Requires a local Tesseract binary with chi_sim language data; see the README for setup.
description.zh: 左侧栏面板：用本地 Tesseract OCR 提取图片文字（中文+英文），并通过内置 translator（Bing 匿名端点，无需密钥）翻译。需本机安装 Tesseract 及 chi_sim 语言数据，安装方法见 README。
